source.note: https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/JAM/indicator/NY.GDP.PCAP.CD?format=json&date=2024. The World Bank has no household consumption series for Jamaica for 2019-2024 (NE.CON.PRVT.CD and NE.CON.PRVT.ZS empty), so models take GDP per person times a consumption share, as for Myanmar.
